meta.title: Add the same to both sides of a subtract
meta.summary: SAMPLE 502−198: add 2 to both → 504−200=304. Not the same as rounding one side.

success.message:
Session complete. Add the same to both; the difference is unchanged.

SAMPLE: 502−198=304, 725−397=328.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 502 − 198. Crossing zeros is ugly.

Move?

choices.label: Borrow across the zeros in columns

wrong_start_one.message:
That rounded one side and forgot the payback. Equal-adjust moves both, so there is no payback.

Return to both sides.

wrong_start_borrow.message:
Works on paper. In the head, push 198 to 200 and bring 502 along.

Return to both sides.

choices.label: It just happens to work for 2
You have to add the 2 back to 304

wrong_why_lucky.message:
Any c works. You pick c so the subtrahend becomes round.

Revisit the identity.

wrong_why_add_ans.message:
No payback. Both sides already moved.

Revisit the identity.

wrong_check_325.message:
You moved only one side. Add 3 to 725 as well.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_331.message:
No payback on this family.

Try the check again.
